svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: an app calls generateJSON, the client tries Anthropic first, gets rate limited, falls back to an OpenAI-compatible provider, validates the reply against the JSON schema and returns data plus the list of attempts; a mock provider covers offline tests
svg.title: How universal-llm-client works
svg.text: One call, a fallback chain across providers, and output checked against your schema
structured output as a tool call

g.text: Your app calls generateJSON with a prompt and a JSON Schema
First in the chain: Claude, with structured output as a forced tool call
Still rate limited after backoff (Retry-After honoured): move on
Fallback: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with a JSON Schema response format
The reply is validated; on a mismatch the model sees the errors and tries once more
data matches your schema, and attempts records anthropic → openai
No keys in CI or demos? End the chain with mock: offline and deterministic
